angle: An API is a contract: you send a request in the agreed shape and the other side sends back a response.

claims.text: An API is a set of rules that lets software interact with another program, as opposed to a human user interface.
If one side sends a request structured a particular way, the other side responds in an agreed way.
The waiter-between-you-and-the-kitchen picture is a teaching analogy, not a technical claim.

sources.title: Red Hat: What is an API?
